contract_model: STANDALONE with respect to r2 - r2 is not an input and no r2+patch composition exists. r1 IS a load-bearing input, normatively incorporated by reference for the surfaces enumerated in R3.1 and nothing else. Composition: effective contract = this document + r1 restricted to those surfaces; where they conflict, r3 prevails.
note: The revision axis is not the protocol version. r1/r2/r3 identify measurement-contract revisions only; no artifact carries one.

contract.sha256: <self; recorded in REVISIONS.md and the P2-B evidence manifest>

incorporated_contract_r1.status: historical - frozen; basis of every measurement recorded to date; never edited
incorporated_contract_r1.role: LOAD-BEARING - normatively incorporated by reference for the R3.1 surfaces only

validation_basis_closure.dialect: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12, pinned by contract and never selected from $schema
validation_basis_closure.format: annotation only; NOT assertion-bearing; no format validation
validation_basis_closure.vocabularies: no custom/external semantic vocabulary; $vocabulary beyond pinned dialect => unusable; no implicit plugin or network loading
validation_basis_closure.refs: intra-document fragment refs permitted; file/network/relative/absolute external refs prohibited; network refs rejected without attempting retrieval
validation_basis_closure.duplicate_members: rejected at every depth, detected during parse, before semantic validation
validation_basis_closure.consequence: basis_digest = sha256(exact self-contained basis document bytes) identifies the complete validation semantics

artifact_schema_aggregate.derivation: For each schema emit '<lowercase-hex-sha256><SP><SP><repo-relative-path><LF>'; sort lines by path under unsigned byte order; concatenate; SHA-256. Equivalent to: sha256sum <files> | LC_ALL=C sort -k2 | sha256sum
artifact_schema_aggregate.authoritative: individual per-schema digests above; the aggregate is a convenience

historical_evidence_boundary: No measurement was made against r2 or r3. The C1 parity run, the historical 60-case corpus and every external run to date were measured against r1 and remain so. No historical external implementation is claimed to implement or pass r2 or r3.

superseded_not_load_bearing.note: Recorded for provenance only. NOT an input to the effective contract.

r2.status: superseded before implementation/measurement - no implementation, corpus, parity or external result exists against it; superseded on a read-only audit, not because a measurement failed
